Title: Best Herbs for Hydroponics: pH, EC, Light & Easiest Picks
Description: Best hydroponic herbs: basil, parsley, mint, chives, oregano, cilantro and thyme. Grow them at pH 5.5–6.0, EC 1.2–2.0 and 12–16 hours of light. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
